svg.title: Railway Reservation System: Kerala Express 12625
svg.desc: Animated banner: a night train rides from Thiruvananthapuram to New Delhi past palms and monuments while taglines describe the FIFO queue reservation system.

g.text: Two hand-written linked-list queues. Zero shortcuts.
Cancel a seat and the right waiting passenger is promoted instantly.
38 seats • 4 classes • a 10-deep FIFO waiting list
FIFO QUEUES • HAND-WRITTEN LINKED LISTS • 38 SEATS, 4 CLASSES • 10-DEEP WAITING LIST • SAME-CLASS AUTO-PROMOTION • LOWEST-FREE-SEAT REUSE • C + GTK3 •
